name: Keep today's send-time assembly
description: Nothing changes. Every gate attempt builds its context at send time: the X writing guide, matt's replies from every platform through the voice index (19.9 MB pairs.json parsed twice), this chat's evidence, and 12 ranked moments embedded and reranked with Jina. The drafter is told to read his messages to them and then his whole history.

name: Scope it to this chat, still built at send time
description: Still built at send time, but the drafter and the gate read only this conversation: its last messages, matt's own messages in it and the moment being answered. Matt's replies from other conversations come in only while he has written fewer than a few messages in this chat. The voice index is opened once per gate instead of twice. Nothing new runs in the background.

name: Index each message as it lands, read the chat from log.db at send
description: The account's owner, which already appends every message to log.db, embeds each new message in the same background step (into the existing embeddings table) and updates that chat's voice-index entries for matt's own replies. At send time the drafter and the gate read this chat's recent messages and its precomputed vectors straight from log.db, ranked locally with no embed calls. Cross-conversation evidence is kept only for a chat where matt has barely written.

name: Index on arrival plus a conversation card per chat
description: Everything in indexOnArrival, plus one small record per chat in log.db (the conversation's schema): who they are, what the conversation is about, what they asked that is still open, what matt already said or asked, and the last few messages. It is updated in the background only when a new message lands in a chat that is being worked (claimed, or with a reply waiting). The drafter gets the card and the last messages, a few hundred words, and drafts one or two short lines answering the open item. The gate reads the same card. Matt's global voice comes in as a short profile, not the whole guide or other chats.
